fixtures.description: One visible pedestrian, source seconds 40-47 slowed to ten seconds and tightly cropped; dark synthetic side padding.
Source seconds 65-75 with multiple pedestrians including observable crossings and partial occlusion; scaled and padded to 720p.
Source seconds 20-60 accelerated four times, then scaled and padded to 720p.

probe.decoder: single-pass MediaExtractor + MediaCodec flexible-YUV decoder; no seeks
probe.peakMemoryMetric: baseline and peak android.os.Debug.getPss process PSS sampled every 20 ms; capability uses peak-minus-baseline delta
probe.pipelineRuntimeMetric: single-pass decode + scale + VIDEO-mode inference + configured-FPS smoothing + motion-normalized mask metrics + ten contact-sheet panel overlays; PNG encoding excluded
probe.latencyMetric: per-frame MediaPipe segmentForVideo wall-clock latency; sequential decode interval between sampled frames
probe.pssDeltaBudgetSource: Task 0.2 explicit 128 MiB process-PSS growth budget

playbackReviews.reviewMethod: Vision review of full-cadence chronological strips containing every JPEG frame, arranged one row per second and assessed for normal-playback continuity, coverage, pumping, and false positives.

observedDefects: Frequent person-mask dropouts and adjacent-frame on/off flicker.
Abrupt area and boundary pumping from absent or partial coverage to large blobs.
False-positive mask regions on curb, grass, and landscaping separate from the person.
Most visible pedestrians remain unmasked or only partially covered through crossings.
Mask fragments appear and disappear between adjacent frames instead of maintaining coverage through occlusion.
Large false-positive regions occur on the ground, path, grass, and right image edge.
Most visible pedestrians are unmasked or receive sparse, misaligned partial coverage.
Large right and lower-edge blobs repeatedly grow, shrink, and disappear between adjacent frames.
Persistent false-positive masks occur on the dark border, grass, pavement, and background objects.
Frequent person-mask dropouts and frame-to-frame flicker remain at the larger working size.
Person coverage is partial and pumps in size and shape across adjacent frames.
Large false-positive regions recur at the grass and sidewalk boundary.
Several visible pedestrians remain unmasked during crossings and clustered occlusion.
Adjacent frames show dropouts and short merged blobs rather than stable subject-shaped coverage.
Mask size pumps and false-positive patches appear on pavement and adjacent non-person areas.
Many pedestrians remain entirely unmasked; detected coverage is tiny, partial, or misaligned.
Frequent adjacent-frame dropouts and border-area pumping remain visible at 15 FPS.
False-positive blobs and strips recur on grass, paths, and image borders.

tracking.reason: Pinned on-device Tasks Vision exposes only a combined person confidence mask and no subject-identity tracker; crossings, occlusions, and cuts cannot be tested without inventing a stub.

videoIsolation.reason: No observed configuration passes all three fixture motion-aware quality thresholds, <=3x realtime, the 128 MiB PSS-delta budget, and cancellation cleanup; no production stub is permitted.

provenance.criterion: Every pinned dependency/model/fixture/generator/license boundary and packaged SHA-256 digest matches

nativePageAlignment.criterion: Packaged arm64 MediaPipe ELF PT_LOAD and actual APK ZIP data offset are both 16 KiB aligned

cancellationCleanup.criterion: Cancellation stops work, closes MediaPipe/sequential-decoder resources, removes partial evidence, and permits follow-up inference

videoIsolation.criterion: A selected 10 s 720p configuration is <=3x realtime, under the 128 MiB peak-PSS-delta budget, and motion-aware quality-acceptable on every fixture

playbackReview.criterion: Every current playback evidence archive has exactly one complete review record bound to its SHA-256
